{{Top|leg}}
'''Eba''' was one of a pair of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] dolls given to [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] after returning from a visit to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], that had occurred prior to their visit to [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]. Jaina's was named Eba and Jacen named his [[Aba]].
